description: Source code for TSL2540 sensor trigger handling in Zephyr OS, including interrupt setup, handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: tsl2540_setup_int
methods.description: Configures the interrupt GPIO pin for the TSL2540 sensor.

methods.name: tsl2540_handle_int
methods.description: Handles the interrupt event, disables further interrupts, and triggers the appropriate handler.

methods.name: tsl2540_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, calls handle_int.

methods.name: tsl2540_process_int
methods.description: Reads and processes the sensor's interrupt status register, calls user handler if needed, and re-enables interrupts.

methods.name: tsl2540_thread_main
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in own thread context.

methods.name: tsl2540_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler for global thread interrupt processing.

methods.name: tsl2540_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the sensor trigger, sets handlers, and enables interrupts if handler is provided.

methods.name: tsl2540_trigger_init
methods.description: Initializes the trigger mechanism, configures GPIO, and sets up threading or work handler.
